Expected Possession Value — a possession-value model estimating how much a team’s current possession is worth in scoring terms.
Goal Difference Added — this workbook’s on/off-style plus-minus model estimating a player’s contribution to goal difference.

Composite *_impact_score fields (Player Standard, Player Impact) are left blank below roughly 400–470 minutes played this season — the sample is judged too small for a reliable composite. See impact_sample_reliability for the per-player confidence weight, and use raw category metrics for low-minute players instead.

A player who changed clubs mid-season appears as one row per club under the same player_id (see transferred_mid_season on Player Standard). Group by player_id alone and you will double-count minutes; group by (player_id, team) to keep club splits separate, or sum across rows for a season total.
Passes Per Defensive Action — opposition passes allowed per defensive action performed; a common pressing-intensity proxy (lower = more intense press).
Post-Shot Expected Goals — xG recalculated using the shot’s actual placement/trajectory rather than pre-shot information alone.
Regularized Adjusted Plus-Minus — a plus-minus estimate adjusted for teammates and opponents via regularized regression.
Valuing Actions by Estimating Probabilities — a possession-value model that scores each on-ball action by its effect on scoring/conceding probability.
Non-Penalty Expected Goals — xG with penalty-kick shots excluded.
Expected Assists — the probability that a given pass becomes a goal assist, based on the resulting shot’s xG.
Expected Goals — the probability that a shot results in a goal, based on shot location and situation.
Expected Goals On Target — the probability that a shot already on target results in a goal.
Expected Threat — the change in scoring probability generated by moving the ball (via pass, carry or take-on) between pitch zones.
